end.summary:
Ishita named sphere and identified football as a sphere.
They distinguished a flat circle from a round sphere.
They identified dice as a cube and a matchbox as a cuboid.
They identified a battery as a cylinder, including when placed on its side.
Cone and full shape-name teach-back were not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes and matching everyday objects to them. Ishita explained that a football is a sphere, a dice has equal-sized faces, a brick has longer and shorter faces, and a battery remains a cylinder when turned. They repeatedly requested photos or sketches that did not appear, so the lesson ended before cone practice and the full teach-back. At home, please use real objects such as a dice, box, battery, ball, and cone to ask Ishita to name each shape.
